verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 is a GPU accelerator and hardware system. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent is an axis for software services, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence mentions BMC interfaces (Redfish, IPMI) and management tooling, but nothing about issuing scoped API credentials, so nothing shows the product ships this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
